notes.title: New Live features are now available
notes.content:
A new live feature is now available on Net Friend Joy Joypad with Live (NFJJ plus).

 What has changed? 
I do not know too. Since the SDK of the new standard came out, it corresponded.
It seems that the development of the old standard SDK will be stopped, and it is not expected to improve the function as it is.
Also, the format has been changed to change the band size on the live distribution side.
I didn't see much of a feature difference in our local tests, but it might be a difference remotely.

notes.title: Compatible with Windows 11
notes.content:
Updated to version 1.2 now!
There are two main changes.

Compatible with Windows 11
Yes! It's definitely compatible with Windows 11. yeah it's true perhaps...  :-( 
Actually, I don't  have Windows 11 so I can't check, but in theory it should work.

Add reload Button (NFJJ Plus)
If you feel lag in the video stream, you can refresh it by clicking the button.
I wonder why this feature hasn't existed before?
